preserved_invariants: one bounded task at a time
PLAN → DISPATCH → VERIFY → ACCEPT/REJECT → NEXT PLAN
deterministic exact-once dispatch_id and relay_id authority
durable state before effect where required
exact target identity and bounded recovery
private chat bodies, tokens, cookies and full private URLs never enter Git
production merge/deploy requires explicit Owner instruction
removed_from_target_architecture: multi-lane page-budget/LRU eviction as a normal-path requirement
polling as the primary ChatGPT completion detector

transient_load_failure: click Retry at most once per recovery epoch
if still failed, reload exact page at most once
recovery_contract.deterministic_missing: quarantine exact target; do not retry/reload storm

latency_targets.note: targets are acceptance budgets, not permission to weaken exact-once/safety

required: 0 unintended Work replacement outside verified rollover
0 Owner intervention during final unattended soak
all latency stages emitted and privacy-safe

assumptions: single execution stream; no three-lane parallel implementation
ChatGPT DOM may require compatibility fixes during bridge work
soak stages are sequential qualification gates
production deployment time is excluded until explicit Owner authorization

phases.title: Architecture Pivot & Source Authority
phases.goal: Establish one canonical V3 source, preserve safety invariants, and freeze legacy Three-Lane as rollback-only.

phases.title: Single-Lane Deterministic Core
phases.goal: Extract a one-project/one-task durable runtime while preserving exact-once and Brain planning semantics.

phases.title: ChatGPT Browser Event Bridge
phases.goal: Make ChatGPT the center with two warm tabs and event-driven detection/action instead of polling as the normal path.

phases.title: Recovery & Resilience
phases.goal: Recover transient ChatGPT/browser failures with bounded retry/reload/reconnect while preserving exact-once state.

phases.title: Latency & Observability
phases.goal: Measure and reduce Robot overhead while keeping correctness and privacy-safe diagnostics.

phases.title: Plus-Only AI Integration Boundary
phases.goal: Keep OpenAI API cost at zero while exposing a transport-neutral local interface that can support future MCP without dependency.

phases.title: Legacy Cleanup & Migration
phases.goal: Remove multi-lane machinery from the V3 path, migrate state safely, and retain an isolated rollback entry point until cutover.

phases.title: Qualification & Owner Cutover
phases.goal: Qualify the locked candidate through smoke, continuous, fault-injection and overnight soak before Owner-authorized deployment.
